visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman in a dark suit and pink mask holds a digital timer on a wooden restaurant table, while a man in glasses sits opposite her. A pixelated 'START' graphic appears over the scene. (2) The camera cuts to a massive, multi-layered burger tower stacked with beef patties, fried chicken, bacon, cheese, and avocado, surrounded by a mountain of fries and onion rings. The man, wearing plastic gloves, begins to dismantle and eat the burger with intensity. (3) Several close-up shots emphasize the texture of the food: pulling apart fried chicken, showing the juicy cross-section of a pink beef patty, and the man stuffing handfuls of fries into his mouth. The lighting is warm and bright, typical of a modern indoor restaurant. (4) The man continues to eat rapidly, occasionally drinking from a glass of milk tea. The woman shows the timer again, indicating the countdown. (5) After finishing most of the food, the man celebrates with two other women in a green booth who are clapping. He then holds a red envelope and counts out five '500' discount vouchers, smiling at the camera.
